name: cmcp
description: Skill-first, host-neutral temporal continuity and memory-governance Runtime with guarded source retrieval and a local reference channel.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded source context with time and event continuity.
interface.longDescription: CMCP keeps authorized source History separate from time, event and continuity interpretation. The project-local context skill and local reference Runtime share guarded source reads; the Host answers from the returned context. Full cross-Host lifecycle integration is not claimed.
